title: Disposition decisions for the first weak-classified EC3 batch

decisions.reason: Direct test assertions check abbreviation precedence in both key orders with literal expected values and no-recovery valid fixtures. The crosswalk label reflects citation discovery only.
Clarifies that Default is not Type 5. It does not create a general reader rejection requirement or screen-generation duty.

Parent read full primary page283 and annotation rectangles. The caret is in NOTE2 optional skipping, not the earlier ID separator exception. Existing separator test covers only one filter; separate chain integration remains worthwhile without inventing an obligation to execute that optimization.

The effective producer restriction excludes enum19; the separate processor-support sentence remains. The current owner departure is specifically for enum19, so no categorical reader non-support conclusion follows.

The replacement Caret repeats the two Domain constraints; neighboring typical-domain text is not the replacement. Existing numeric tests check valid fractional/negative exponents in valid domains. No new reader behavior gap is established.
Spelling/layout and the Unicode four-or-five-digit explanatory notation correction do not alter runtime behavior; the Annex A operator pointer does not alter operator semantics.
DPM constraints are producer requirements conditioned on downstream production workflow; the app has no DPM consumer and preserves the dictionary opaquely.

Two exact-xref tests now assert standalone and stream-to-stream traversal, previous catalog resolution and newest-entry precedence, without recovery or a cut chain. Mixed section/stream forms remain allowed.
The sampled annotations alter example spacing/layout and clarify a direct-object producer rule already stated in nearby text; no new reader behavior is required.
The note warns of ordering/interoperability consequences, not a catalog-in-object-stream ban. The separate #439 producer restriction remains distinct.

adr_review.relevance: Historical correction account identifies the #101 startxref change from decoded-stream-relative wording to PDF-file offsets; it also records that parsing code already accepted stream starts.

Current /Prev recovery decision concerns offsets naming no readable section. It does not establish an assertion for valid xref-stream-to-xref-stream chains; do not extend that ADR's malformed-input conclusion to this valid case.

ADR1184 separates the producer enum19 restriction from processor support. A348 records the current narrow owner departure after buying PIMA7667 and declining CIE131; historical unavailable-source claims are not current global facts. ADR0348 is unrelated.
Current DPart decision supports #86's inapplicable downstream-workflow boundary; it does not transform DPM producer constraints into reader rejection requirements.
Continuous-tone output route scopes the halftone-screen duty for #12; it does not remove Type 5 transfer-function interpretation.
